dialogues.speaker: Cai Xun
dialogues.text: Welcome to Liyue. How may the Millelith be of service to you today?

dialogues.speaker: Cai Xun
dialogues.text: Tell me more about the Millelith.

dialogues.speaker: Cai Xun
dialogues.text: "While rock stays hard, the mountain shall never fail; while the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevail."

dialogues.speaker: Cai Xun
dialogues.text: The Millelith are under the Liyue Qixing's command. You could say we're the city's public security officers.

dialogues.speaker: Cai Xun
dialogues.text: We're here to handle minor matters such as theft and other disturbances of the peace. We also stand ready as Liyue's firm shield in the case of a monster attack.

dialogues.speaker: Cai Xun
dialogues.text: Never hesitate to call on us if you need assistance of any kind.

dialogues.speaker: Cai Xun
dialogues.text: While the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevail!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you seen someone who looks very much like me?

dialogues.speaker: Cai Xun
dialogues.text: Hmm, this is a difficult question to answer.

dialogues.speaker: Cai Xun
dialogues.text: It's not that I'm lazy and don't observe the people who come and go, but...

dialogues.speaker: Cai Xun
dialogues.text: Liyue Harbor is the most prosperous city among the seven nations. There are just too many people who move to and from it every day — it's impossible to remember them all.

dialogues.speaker: Cai Xun
dialogues.text: I'll help you keep a lookout, but don't get your hopes too high...
